what: SA3 evidence for the RB-P4 critic-only replay, persisted because it was load-bearing and existed only as prose. The critic alone scores the byte-identical answer {"port": 9443} for nav-prod-port on qwen2.5:14b-instruct, at the three pinned seeds, under the before-rubric (d2f78b7) and the shipped after-rubric (e57f1a6). The answerer is never re-run: the answer string is held fixed, which is the point of the replay. Each cell was run in FIVE separate OS processes to separate a stable score from a lucky sample, and the exact request payload of every call is hashed so a replay that judged a different question is detectable rather than assumed away.
